boards.name: Raspberry Pi Pico
boards.flash: Hold BOOTSEL, plug in, copy the file onto the drive that appears
boards.notes: Unbrickable — the RP2040 mask ROM always gives you BOOTSEL back

boards.name: Adafruit Feather nRF52840
boards.flash: SWD, both files in order without resetting in between
boards.notes: Back the board up first — this erases the Adafruit UF2 bootloader and its UICR settings, and there is no ROM loader to fall back on

boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3 (DevKitC-compatible)
boards.notes: Hardware on order. Needs the module dtsi swapped for the N16R8 variant and a partition table chosen — see docs/HARDWARE_TARGETS.md

boards.name: Adafruit RP2040 CAN Bus Feather
boards.notes: Hardware on order. Zephyr has the board and `zephyr,canbus` is already chosen, but it ships no MCUboot slots, so a partition variant needs writing
